title: Home Page Load and Navigation
description: Verify that the Home Page loads correctly without errors and that navigation links work properly.

steps.description: Navigate to the Home Page at route '/'
Verify the page loads without 404 errors
Verify no console errors exist on page load
Verify that main UI elements and feature highlights display correctly
Click navigation links to Authentication (/login), Lessons (/lessons), and Dashboard (/dashboard)
Verify each navigated page loads without error

title: Authentication Pages Accessibility
description: Verify that the Login and Signup pages load correctly and UI elements render properly.

steps.description: Navigate to the Login Page at route '/login'
Verify the page loads without 404 errors
Verify that login form UI elements (email, password input, submit button) render correctly
Verify no console errors exist on page load
Navigate to the Signup Page at route '/signup'
Verify the page loads without 404 errors
Verify that signup form UI elements (email, password input, submit button) render correctly
Verify no console errors exist on page load

title: Dashboard Page Access and UI Validation
description: Verify the protected Dashboard page loads correctly and displays user information UI elements properly.

steps.description: Navigate to the Dashboard Page at route '/dashboard'
Verify that the page loads without 404 errors
Check that user information section and dashboard components render correctly
Verify that no console errors appear on page load

title: Lessons Listing and Individual Lesson Page Load
description: Verify lessons list and individual lesson page render correctly without errors for valid lesson IDs.

steps.description: Navigate to Lessons listing page at route '/lessons'
Verify page loads without 404 errors
Verify that lessons list UI elements are rendered correctly
Verify no console errors on page load
Navigate to an individual lesson page at route '/lesson/1' (assuming lesson id=1 exists)
Verify page loads without 404 errors
Verify individual lesson content renders correctly
Verify no console errors on page load
Navigate to an invalid lesson ID page e.g. '/lesson/invalid-id'
Verify that the app handles the invalid route properly (e.g. shows not found or appropriate error UI)

title: Quiz Page Access and UI Rendering
description: Verify that quiz pages load with correct UI components and handle invalid quiz IDs properly.

steps.description: Navigate to quiz page with valid ID at route '/quiz/1'
Verify quiz page loads without 404 error
Verify quiz UI elements such as questions and submit buttons are rendered
Verify no console errors on page load
Navigate to quiz page with invalid ID at route '/quiz/invalid-id'
Verify the app handles invalid quiz ID gracefully (shows error or not found)

title: User Progress Page Accessibility and UI Validation
description: Verify that the user progress page loads properly and displays progress tracking elements.

steps.description: Navigate to user progress page at route '/progress'
Verify the page loads without 404 errors
Verify progress indicators and charts display correctly
Verify no console errors on page load

title: Billing Page Load and UI Elements Verification
description: Verify that the billing management page loads correctly and billing UI components render without errors.

steps.description: Navigate to billing page at route '/billing'
Verify the page loads with no 404 errors
Verify billing details, payment methods, and subscription management UI elements are visible
Verify no console errors appear on page load

title: User Settings Page Accessibility and UI Verification
description: Verify the settings page loads and all relevant user settings UI elements render correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to settings page at route '/settings'
Verify page loads without 404 error
Verify that various settings options and input fields are rendered properly
Verify no console errors on page load

title: Profile Page Load and UI Elements
description: Ensure user profile page loads without errors and all profile related UI is displayed accurately.

steps.description: Navigate to profile page at route '/profile'
Verify the page does not return 404 errors
Verify that profile information fields and related UI elements are rendered correctly
Verify no console errors on page load

title: Navigation Between All Major Routes
description: Validate navigation works properly between all major application pages without page load errors.

steps.description: From Home Page '/', navigate to each route in sequence: /login, /signup, /dashboard, /lessons, /lesson/1, /quiz/1, /progress, /billing, /settings, /profile
Verify that each page loads without 404 errors and UI elements render correctly
Ensure no console errors are logged on any page load

title: Page Load Without Console Errors
description: Verify across all tested routes that no console errors or warnings are present on page load.

steps.description: Visit each route: '/', '/login', '/signup', '/dashboard', '/lessons', '/lesson/1', '/quiz/1', '/progress', '/billing', '/settings', '/profile'
Check browser console and confirm that there are no JavaScript errors or warnings on page load
